caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden grandfather clock set against a plain beige background. The clock is composed of a broad, vertical base with a narrower central section featuring a rectangular door that has a small, round knob for opening. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain patterns, giving a textured appearance. At the top is a square-enclosed clock face, which is white or light grey with black Roman numerals marking the hours. The clock has two black hands and an inner dial with smaller subdivisions. The top section is visibly distinct from the body by right angles and shading differences, displaying solid construction. Overall, the composition centers the clock on the page without including any other objects or background elements.
title: Shaker Grandmother Clock
